   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Oct 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _robert perrotta_, Oct 19, 2026, 1/5: "app is absolutely garbage. Will be looking for something better. constantly crashes. Will log meals and they will completely disappear. meals don't save, receipes don't save. Will do all the work to make a meal or recipe, disappears and try to redo it and it says one exists... app will also ghost add stuff you never logged. to say this is trash is an understatement. take our money and fix nothing... garbage business model."
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, Aug 30, 2026, 1/5: "New update is really bad and user unfriendly. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
